bands.label: Thin
bands.blurb: Limited machine-readable signal beyond documentation a human can read.

providers.name: AspenTech
providers.description: AspenTech (Aspen Technology, Inc.) is a global leader in industrial software for asset optimization across the energy, chemicals, and manufacturing industries. AspenTech provides process simulation, optimization, and industrial IoT platforms including the aspenONE suite and Inmation industrial data platform. The Inmation platform provides Web API and Simple Call Interface (SCI) APIs for external applications to interact with industrial IoT and time-series process data via HTTP and WebSocket interfaces. AspenTech serves refineries, petrochemical plants, power generation facilities, and other industrial operations worldwide.

providers.name: Knowde
providers.description: Knowde is an AI platform for industrial operations, built for the chemicals and ingredients industry. Knowde AI extracts, structures, harmonizes and enriches product data out of legacy systems and offline documents; Knowde MDM is the master data repository that data lands in; Knowde CXP launches supplier storefronts natively integrated with MDM; and the Knowde Marketplace is a network of 8,000+ chemical company storefronts. The Knowde API gives customers programmatic access to that platform through a GraphQL API (the recommended primary interface) and a RESTful JSON API, both served from developer-api.knowde.com behind OAuth 2.0 client credentials, with API Clients provisioned in the Developer Portal and a documented PIMS filter grammar for querying product, category and attribute data.

providers.name: Uncountable
providers.description: Uncountable is a unified laboratory informatics and R&D data platform for enterprise research organizations, replacing disconnected LIMS, ELN, QMS and PLM tools with a single cloud system that centralizes experimental data, accelerates formulation work, and supports AI-driven discovery across chemicals, advanced materials, batteries, plastics, coatings, food and life sciences. The platform is delivered as a multi-region SaaS application (US and EU deployments) and exposes an authenticated External API plus a hosted, OAuth-protected Model Context Protocol (MCP) server so agents and integration tooling can read platform data, alongside SFTP and instrument/ERP connectors.

providers.name: Air Products and Chemicals
providers.description: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc. is a global industrial gases company founded in 1940 and headquartered in Allentown, Pennsylvania. It is one of the largest producers of hydrogen and helium worldwide, supplying atmospheric, process, and specialty gases including nitrogen, oxygen, argon, hydrogen, helium, and carbon dioxide, as well as related equipment and engineering services to customers in manufacturing, healthcare, technology, energy, and other industries. Air Products does not currently provide a public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable contract. A live Axway (Vordel) API gateway operates at api.airproducts.com but blocks every anonymous path with a SOAP MessageBlocked fault, and customer ordering and tank telemetry sit behind the MyAirProducts login; integration is provisioned bilaterally under a gas supply agreement.

bands.label: Emerging
bands.blurb: More than an index entry but still mostly links rather than artifacts.

providers.name: Sherwin-Williams
providers.description: The Sherwin-Williams Company is a global leader in the paint and coatings industry, offering products for consumers, contractors, industrial clients, and commercial builders. Sherwin-Williams provides B2B API and EDI integration capabilities for suppliers and trading partners to connect with their enterprise supply chain and retail operations.

providers.name: LanzaTech
providers.description: LanzaTech is a carbon recycling company (Nasdaq LNZA) that uses gas fermentation to convert waste carbon into fuels and chemicals. Its technology retrofits an industrial site such as a steel mill, a ferroalloy plant or a landfill with a bioreactor in which proprietary bacteria consume carbon-rich off-gases and produce ethanol and other intermediates, marketed as CarbonSmart products and used by brands including Unilever, Coty and Zara. The company operates commercial plants in China, India and Belgium, is building the LanzaTech Porsgrunn CCUS project in Norway with Eramet, and works with LanzaJet on sustainable aviation fuel. LanzaTech publishes no developer program, but lanzatech.com runs on WordPress and exposes a fully public, unauthenticated WordPress REST API whose custom content types (news, employee, board-member, download, testimonial) model the company itself.

providers.name: Evolved By Nature
providers.description: Evolved By Nature is a Needham, Massachusetts biotechnology company — formerly Silk Therapeutics — that develops Activated Silk, a platform of liquid silk-derived molecules used as renewable bioactive ingredients and performance chemistries across personal care, skincare, leather finishing and textiles. The company sells physical product rather than software: there is no developer program, no OpenAPI and no API key issuance. Its only live machine-readable API surface is the agentic-commerce layer on its two Shopify storefronts, where UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol) and Shopify storefront MCP endpoints, a storefront GraphQL API, llms.txt and agents.md are served anonymously from evolvedbynature.com hosts.

providers.name: Citrine Informatics
providers.description: Citrine Informatics is an enterprise AI software company for materials and chemicals product development, positioning itself as the world leader in generative AI for the space. The Citrine Platform pairs Citrine DataManager (capturing and organizing organizational materials knowledge on the open-source GEMD data model) with Citrine VirtualLab (running thousands of virtual experiments via Sequential Learning to identify promising formulations), supported by Citrine Catalyst and professional services. Developers integrate through the first-party Python SDK (the "citrine" and "gemd" PyPI libraries) to upload and manage data, build tables, and configure predictors and design spaces. Citrine serves 15+ industries including specialty chemicals, coatings/adhesives/sealants, plastics, personal care, food & beverage, batteries, and metals & alloys, with customers such as LyondellBasell, Eastman, Grace, Stepan, and Collano, plus a DARPA INTACT ceramics program.

providers.name: EnergyX
providers.description: EnergyX (Energy Exploration Technologies, Inc.) is a critical-materials technology company founded in 2018 by Teague Egan and headquartered in Austin, Texas, with operations in Texarkana, Antofagasta in Chile, and San Juan, Puerto Rico. It develops direct lithium extraction (DLE) technology — a modular, brine-agnostic flow sheet combining adsorbents, solvent extraction and its own selective membranes under the GET-Lit platform — together with SoLiS lithium-metal battery technology and NUKE-it membranes for lithium-6/7 isotope separation and nuclear fuel-cycle applications. The company produces lithium hydroxide, lithium carbonate and lithium dihydrogen phosphate, holds a large patent portfolio, and controls lithium resources in Chile and the United States including the Black Giant project. EnergyX is a materials and process-technology company rather than a software vendor: it publishes no developer program, no API documentation, no SDKs and no developer portal. The only machine-readable interface it exposes is the WordPress REST content API behind its corporate website at energyx.com, which is captured here for discovery purposes and is anonymously readable but read-only.

providers.name: Standard Industries
providers.description: Standard Industries is a privately-held global industrial company headquartered in New York City and tracing its origins to 1886. The company operates a portfolio of building solutions, performance materials, logistics, real estate, and investment businesses, with more than 20,000 employees and approximately $11 billion in annual revenues. Standard Building Solutions includes GAF (North America's largest roofing manufacturer), GAF Energy (Timberline Solar nailable solar shingles), BMI Group (Europe's largest pitched and flat roofing manufacturer, with brands including Braas, Monier, Icopal, Wolfin, and Redland), Siplast (specialty roofing and waterproofing for iconic structures), SGI (mining and mineral processing), Schiedel (flue, stove, and ventilation systems), and Standard Logistics. Performance Materials is anchored by W. R. Grace & Co., which produces catalysts, engineered materials, process technologies, and fine chemicals. Standard Investments deploys capital across public equities and early-to-growth venture investments. Winter Properties is a vertically integrated real estate firm with more than 100 years of history in New York City. Standard Industries does not publish a public developer API or developer portal at the corporate level; technology integration with customers and partners is handled inside the individual operating companies (most notably GAF and Grace).

providers.name: Valdera
providers.description: Valdera is the AI-powered sourcing and procurement platform for chemicals, ingredients, and raw materials, matching buyers with vetted global suppliers across a database of 400K+ suppliers and 1.7M+ unique chemistries. Buyers get supplier discovery, RFQs, and negotiation in one place; suppliers receive relevant inbound RFQs and fulfill orders on the platform. Valdera is a web platform, not an API provider — it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or SDKs.

providers.name: Imubit
providers.description: Imubit is a Houston-based industrial AI company behind the Optimizing Brain, the process industry's first Closed Loop AI Optimization (AIO) solution powered by deep reinforcement learning. Its cloud-based platform learns a dynamic model from a plant's own historian and DCS data, then writes optimal setpoints back through existing control-system infrastructure to continuously optimize throughput, yield, energy use and emissions. Imubit reports 100+ closed-loop applications deployed across refining, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals and polymers, cement and building materials, and mining, minerals and metals, and is trusted by 7 of the 10 largest U.S. refiners. Imubit publishes no public developer API; its GitHub organization ships open-source Python libraries for pulling data from industrial historians (OSIsoft PI, Aspen IP21) and supporting infrastructure.

providers.name: Arkema
providers.description: Arkema S.A. is a French specialty materials company headquartered in La Defense, Paris and listed on Euronext Paris under ticker AKE. The group is organized around three Specialty Materials segments — Adhesive Solutions (anchored by the Bostik brand), Advanced Materials (high-performance polymers including Kynar PVDF, Rilsan polyamides, Pebax elastomers, Sartomer photocurable resins) and Coating Solutions (acrylic monomers, waterborne and solvent-borne resins, additives) — plus a smaller Intermediates business. Arkema employs roughly 21,000 people across 55 countries with about 154 production plants and 17 R&D centers, generating around EUR 9.1 billion in 2025 revenue. Strategy is anchored in materials science, decarbonization and a validated 1.5 degree SBTi pathway toward Net-Zero by 2050. Arkema does not publish a public developer portal or REST API; customer integrations and product data are exchanged through commercial sales channels, the Product Finder web UI and Safety Data Sheet downloads.

providers.name: Chemius
providers.description: Chemius is a cloud-based chemical compliance platform that automates Safety Data Sheet (SDS), Technical Data Sheet (TDS), and regulatory label creation in 38+ languages for organizations handling chemical products. The platform exposes an API suite covering SDS, TDS, ADR transport documentation, ERP integration, labels, web shop product data, and PDF generation, and offers AI-assisted authoring through the Chemius AI SDS assistant. Chemius is hosted in DIN ISO/IEC 27001-certified German data centers and supports CLP 1272/2008, REACH 1907/2006, detergents, aerosols, and US OSHA / GHS regulatory frameworks.

providers.name: Ashland
providers.description: Ashland is a global specialty chemicals company headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, that provides high-performance ingredients and additives for the pharmaceutical, personal care, food and beverage, coatings, adhesives, and industrial markets. The company's product portfolio includes cellulose ethers, vinyl pyrrolidone polymers, acrylates, and specialty polymers sold under brands such as Benecel, Klucel, Natrosol, Plasdone, and Povidone. Ashland serves over 10,000 customers in more than 100 countries. Ashland does not offer a public developer API but provides digital product selection tools, safety data sheets, and technical documentation through its website.

providers.name: Celanese
providers.description: Celanese Corporation is a global chemical and specialty materials company that produces high-performance engineered polymers and acetyl products used across automotive, medical, consumer, and industrial applications. Celanese has no publicly documented developer API; digital engagement is delivered through the Chemille digital materials assistant for product search and selection, and a Cognite Data Fusion based manufacturing data platform for internal operations.

providers.name: Kyrok
providers.description: Kyrok GmbH is a Berlin-based software company building an AI operating system for mid-sized pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers in Europe. The platform layers over a company's existing ERP (SAP S/4HANA, SAP R/3, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Infor, Applus) and connects the systems supply chain teams currently hold together by hand into intelligent operations across customer service, production planning, material planning and procurement. Kyrok positions itself on an "AI assists, people decide" model, running on European infrastructure in Frankfurt am Main, GDPR-compliant, with ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certifications in progress. The company announced a EUR 3.1M round in June 2026 and names AnalytiChem and Konapharma as customers. Kyrok connects to ERP systems via API but publishes no public developer API, API reference, or SDKs as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Goodfellow
providers.description: Goodfellow (Goodfellow Advanced Materials) is a global specialty-materials supplier founded in 1946 and headquartered in Cambridgeshire, United Kingdom, serving research, prototyping and specialized manufacturing markets in more than 111 countries. Its catalog spans over 70,000 stocked products drawn from 700+ different materials in many forms, including metals, alloys, ceramics, polymers, composites, compounds and glass, alongside custom fabrication and laboratory testing services. Customers include universities, government research facilities, laboratories and advanced manufacturers, served through subsidiaries in the United States, China, France and Germany. Goodfellow was acquired by Battery Ventures in 2021 to help digitize its operations and fund materials acquisitions. Goodfellow is a business-to-business e-commerce and catalog operation; it does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, SDKs or webhooks.

providers.name: Valspar
providers.description: The Valspar Corporation was a global manufacturer of paints and coatings founded in 1806 before being acquired by Sherwin-Williams in 2017 for approximately $11.3 billion. Valspar continues to operate as a brand within Sherwin-Williams, offering consumer paints, industrial coatings, and protective coatings. Digital tools include color visualizers, virtual painters, and color consultation services. No public developer API is available; color and product integrations are available through Sherwin-Williams' partner programs including BIMsmith and Autodesk Revit.

providers.name: HZO
providers.description: HZO is a protective coating company specializing in Parylene and thin-film conformal coatings that safeguard electronics from moisture, humidity, salt fog, corrosion, and harsh chemicals. Founded in Salt Lake City and now headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, HZO delivers turnkey coating services and manufacturing solutions across consumer electronics, automotive and mobility, industrial, medical device, IoT, and battery markets, with coating facilities and centers of excellence in the United States, Hungary, China, and Vietnam. HZO is a physical-materials and contract-manufacturing business ("Protection from the Inside Out") rather than a software vendor: it publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract. This profile records the public web hygiene surface it does serve — an llms.txt discovery file, an RFC 9116 security.txt, and domain security posture.

providers.name: Bayer
providers.description: Bayer is a German multinational pharmaceutical and life sciences company operating across pharmaceuticals, consumer health, and crop science. Bayer does not publish a single corporate-level public developer portal; integration is delivered through enterprise partner programs, the Bayer Crop Science Climate FieldView ecosystem (partner-gated APIs and certified-partner integrations), pharmacovigilance and clinical-trial data exchange, and EDI / x12 channels with distributors and pharmacy benefit managers.

providers.name: H.B. Fuller Company
providers.description: H.B. Fuller Company is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The H.B. Fuller Company API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Ferro Corporation
providers.description: Ferro Corporation is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Ferro Corporation API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Tronox Holdings
providers.description: Tronox Holdings is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Tronox Holdings API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Westlake Chemical
providers.description: Westlake Chemical (now Westlake Corporation) is a global manufacturer and supplier of petrochemicals, polymers, building products, and specialty chemicals. The company produces ethylene, polyethylene, PVC, chlor-alkali, epoxy resins, and fabricated building products serving packaging, healthcare, automotive, consumer goods, and construction markets worldwide.

providers.name: Gradiant
providers.description: Gradiant is a global water and wastewater infrastructure company founded in 2013 out of MIT and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, that designs, builds and operates end-to-end industrial water systems from intake to discharge. It positions itself as "the Water Layer of the AI Economy", supplying ultrapure water, process water, wastewater recycling, minimal- and zero-liquid-discharge and resource-recovery systems to semiconductor fabs, AI data centers, energy producers and applied industries including pharmaceuticals, mining, food and beverage, refining and chemicals, textiles and renewables. Its proprietary technology portfolio includes Counterflow Reverse Osmosis (CFRO), Semi-Batch Reverse Osmosis (SBRO), Carrier Gas Extraction (CGE), Selective Contaminant Extraction (SCE), Free Radical Oxidation (FRO), Bio Infinity, the ForeverGone PFAS destruction process, the HyperSolved data-center cooling-water platform, the CURE Chemicals specialty-chemicals line and SmartOps AI, a machine-learning platform for optimizing and predicting plant operations. Gradiant raised a Series E at a $2 billion valuation in May 2026. It is an industrial equipment, chemicals and build-own-operate services company: it publishes no public developer portal, no developer API, no SDK and no machine-readable API contract, and SmartOps AI is delivered as a customer-facing operations platform rather than as a public API.

providers.name: Polymateria
providers.description: Polymateria Ltd is a British materials-science company, based at the Imperial College I-HUB on the White City Campus in London, that develops Biotransformation — a masterbatch additive blended into polyethylene and polypropylene at roughly 2% by weight so that plastic which escapes a waste stream weathers into a bioavailable wax and fully biodegrades in the open environment without leaving microplastics behind. The company co-authored BSI PAS 9017, the first standard for measuring the biodegradability of polyolefins, is a World Economic Forum Technology Pioneer and a Terra Carta signatory, and sells to converters, brand owners and packaging manufacturers rather than to developers. Its product is a chemical additive, not software: the public website is a WordPress marketing and media site, and the only credentialed surface it operates is a customer portal that serves third-party test datasets as documents. No developer program, public API, SDK or machine-readable API contract of any kind was found in this pass.

providers.name: Cabot Corporation
providers.description: Cabot Corporation is a global specialty chemicals and performance materials company serving the transportation, infrastructure, environment, and consumer industries. The company's products include reinforcing carbons, specialty carbons, fumed silica, inkjet colorants, and engineered elastomer composites.

providers.name: Twelve
providers.description: Twelve is a carbon transformation company that converts CO2, water, and renewable electricity into fuels and chemicals that serve as drop-in replacements for petroleum-based products. Its proprietary eManufacturing technology powers AirPlant One in Moses Lake, Washington, which produces E-Jet sustainable aviation fuel and E-Naphtha, while its eMade program partners with consumer brands on CO2-made materials. Investors include TPG, DCVC, Microsoft, Carbon Direct, Breakout Ventures, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. Twelve publishes no public developer API, but its Wix-hosted site exposes an llms.txt and a live site MCP endpoint for agentic access.

providers.name: actnano
providers.description: actnano, Inc. is a Massachusetts-based advanced materials company that develops and manufactures PFAS-free protective nanocoatings for electronics. Its flagship Advanced nanoGUARD technology is a gel-state, 100% fluorine-free conformal coating applied to printed circuit board assemblies, connectors, antennas, LEDs and high-heat-generating components, delivering up to IPx8 moisture and condensation protection without trapping heat or degrading signal integrity. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, with a Munich center of excellence and operations in Mexico and Japan, actnano serves mobility and automotive electronics, consumer electronics, AI and data-center infrastructure, solar, industrial electronics, medical devices and optical anti-fog applications. The company states REACH and RoHS compliance and ISO 9001:2015 certification, and is backed by BMW i Ventures, Porsche Ventures and Emerald Technology Ventures. actnano is a materials manufacturer: it publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Minerals Technologies
providers.description: Minerals Technologies is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Minerals Technologies API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Quaker Houghton
providers.description: Quaker Houghton is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Quaker Houghton API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: RPM International
providers.description: RPM International Inc. is a multinational specialty coatings and sealants company headquartered in Medina, Ohio, with annual revenues of approximately $7.4 billion. RPM operates a portfolio of over 100 leading brands across three segments: Consumer (Rust-Oleum, DAP, Zinsser), Construction (Tremco, Dryvit, Flowcrete), and Performance Coatings (Carboline, Stonhard, Plasite). RPM International does not currently offer a public developer API, but its subsidiaries and brands serve the construction, maintenance, and protective coatings markets globally.

providers.name: Scimplify
providers.description: Scimplify is a Bengaluru-based advanced specialty chemicals company that combines deep chemical expertise, software, and global manufacturing capacity to make complex chemical supply predictable at scale. Founded in 2023, it operates as a contract research (CRO) and contract manufacturing (CMO) organization across the specialty-chemicals lifecycle, serving pharmaceutical, agrochemical, flavors & fragrances, industrial, beauty & personal care, food & nutrition, dyes & pigments, oleochemicals, flame retardants, and critical-metals industries. Its integrated Scinode platform, IONS R&D and ATOMS manufacturing ecosystems, and Scira AI agentic layer coordinate discovery, sourcing, and production. Scimplify publishes no public developer API; this profile captures its web, content, and domain-security surface.

providers.name: Stepan Company
providers.description: Stepan Company is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Stepan Company API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Linde
providers.description: Linde is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Linde API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: Worldover
providers.description: Worldover is the AI operating system for chemicals and cosmetics companies, replacing fragmented ERP, PLM, QMS, LIMS, and regulatory tools with one AI-orchestrated system custom-built around each team's workflows. Powered by Willow, its chemical and regulatory intelligence engine, it runs AI agents for demand planning, regulatory monitoring, quality, formulation R&D, supply chain, SDS authoring, and PLM updates. Headquartered in London and backed by Index Ventures, Chalfen, and EF, Worldover serves beauty brands, manufacturers, ingredient providers, distributors, and pharma and supplements companies. No public developer API is published.

providers.name: ResourceWise
providers.description: ResourceWise is a market intelligence company for sustainable commodities, delivering data, analytics, pricing benchmarks, forecasts, and consulting across the forest products, pulp and paper, biofuels, and chemicals markets. It was formed by unifying established industry brands including Tecnon OrbiChem, Wood Resources International, Fisher International, Forest2Market, Prima Markets, and Chemical Intelligence under the ResourceWise name. Its subscription platforms include ChemEdge360, FisherSolve, Forestat Global, OrbiChem360, Prima CarbonZero, Recycled Fiber 360, SilvaStat360, and WoodMarket Prices. The company is backed by Battery Ventures. No public API or developer portal is currently published; access is delivered through its SaaS platform logins.

providers.name: W. R. Grace
providers.description: W. R. Grace & Co. is a global producer of specialty chemicals and specialty materials, providing catalysts and process technologies to refining, petrochemical, and other manufacturers. Grace operates in two segments: Catalysts Technologies (fluid catalytic cracking catalysts, additives, and process technologies) and Materials Technologies (silica-based engineered materials for pharmaceutical, food, coatings, and industrial applications). Grace's Fine Chemical Manufacturing Services division provides active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) development and manufacturing for the pharmaceutical industry. W. R. Grace does not offer a public developer API for software integration.

providers.name: CF Industries Holdings
providers.description: CF Industries Holdings is a Fortune 500 American manufacturer and distributor of nitrogen-based fertilizers (ammonia, urea, ammonium nitrate, UAN) and clean-energy products serving agricultural and industrial customers worldwide. CF operates one of the largest global ammonia production networks and is scaling clean (blue and green) ammonia for low-carbon energy. CF does not publish a public developer API program; programmatic data access is limited to investor-relations SEC filings feeds, press/news RSS, and partner EDI/B2B integrations with agricultural distributors, rail, terminal, and industrial customers.

providers.name: Air Company
providers.description: Air Company (AIRCO) is a carbon conversion technology company founded in 2017 by Gregory Constantine and Dr. Stafford Sheehan. Its patented Carbon Conversion Reactor mimics photosynthesis, combining captured CO2, water and green hydrogen with renewable energy to produce carbon-negative alcohols and fully formulated synthetic fuels. The company licenses its catalytic process technologies and designs deployable production systems, from the container-scale AIRCO MAD Fuel System to the AIRCO SAF Factory. Product lines are branded AIRMADE and span sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), ethanol, methanol, diesel and rocket fuel, with earlier consumer validation products including AIR Vodka and AIR Eau de Parfum. Partners and customers include the U.S. Department of Defense, U.S. Air Force, Department of Energy and NASA, alongside aviation partners such as Virgin, Air France-KLM, JetBlue and Air Canada; strategic investors include Alaska Airlines, Carbon Direct, In-Q-Tel and Toyota Ventures. Air Company publishes no public API, developer portal or machine-readable API contract as of the 2026-07-31 enrichment pass.

providers.name: Innospec
providers.description: Innospec is a major US corporation and Fortune 1000 company. The Innospec API provides programmatic access to its platform services, data, and integrations for enterprise customers and partners.

providers.name: A. Schulman
providers.description: A. Schulman was a global supplier of high-performance plastic compounds, composites, and powders used by manufacturers across packaging, automotive, electronics, and consumer goods industries. The company was acquired by LyondellBasell in 2018 and now operates as the Advanced Polymer Solutions division, continuing to supply engineered plastics, masterbatches, compounds, and specialty powders to global manufacturers.

providers.name: LanzaJet
providers.description: LanzaJet is a sustainable fuels technology company, headquartered at 520 Lake Cook Road, Deerfield, Illinois, that produces and licenses sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and renewable diesel. Founded in 2020 as a spin-out of LanzaTech with Suncor and Mitsui, and later backed by Shell, British Airways, Southwest Airlines, Microsoft's Climate Innovation Fund, Breakthrough Energy, Groupe ADP, MUFG and All Nippon Airways, the company commercializes a patented Alcohol-to-Jet (ATJ) process that converts ethanol into synthetic paraffinic kerosene through a continuous catalytic reaction, reaching roughly 90% hydrocarbon selectivity to jet fuel and converting about 98% of the ethanol carbon into salable product. The ATJ pathway was approved by ASTM International in 2018. LanzaJet Freedom Pines Fuels in Soperton, Georgia — opened in 2024 — is the world's first commercial ethanol-to-jet SAF plant, producing roughly 10 million gallons of SAF and renewable diesel a year, and the company is developing Project Speedbird in the UK alongside a CirculAir joint solution with LanzaTech that widens the feedstock base to municipal solid waste, agricultural residues and industrial off-gases via gas fermentation. LanzaJet sells technology licenses, project development and engineering services and fuel offtake rather than software: as of this profiling pass it publishes no public developer portal, no API reference, no SDKs, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind, and every /.well-known/ discovery probe against its web host returned 404.

providers.name: Monolith Materials
providers.description: Monolith (legally Monolith Inc., formerly Monolith Materials) is an American chemicals and advanced-materials manufacturer headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska and founded in 2012. It is the first company to run methane pyrolysis at commercial scale, using an electrified thermal-plasma process to split natural gas or renewable biogas into solid carbon and clean hydrogen with no direct CO2 combustion. The solid carbon is finished into carbon black for tire, rubber, plastics, battery and electronics manufacturing, and the co-produced hydrogen is used on-site or converted into anhydrous ammonia. Monolith operates a demonstration plant in Redwood City, California and its commercial Olive Creek facility in Hallam, Nebraska, which since 2023 has supplied made-in-Nebraska carbon black to Goodyear. Monolith is a physical materials producer and sells industrial product, not software: it publishes no developer program, no public API, and no machine-readable API contract of any kind.

providers.name: OCSiAl
providers.description: OCSiAl is a Luxembourg-headquartered advanced-materials manufacturer and the world's largest industrial producer of single wall carbon nanotubes (graphene nanotubes), sold under the TUBALL brand. Founded in 2010, the company industrialised nanotube synthesis with its Graphetron reactors and now supplies TUBALL nanotubes, TUBALL MATRIX concentrates and TUBALL BATT dispersions as conductive and reinforcing additives to lithium-ion battery electrode, elastomer, thermoplastic, coating, composite and ESD-flooring producers. TUBALL was the first single wall carbon nanotube registered under EU REACH and covered by a US EPA consent order. OCSiAl operates production and dispersion facilities in Luxembourg and Serbia plus laboratories and TUBALL CENTERs in Europe and Asia, with commercial representation in more than 20 countries. It is a materials producer, not a software vendor, and publishes no public API, developer portal or SDK.

providers.name: Albemarle
providers.description: Albemarle Corporation is a global specialty chemicals company and leading provider of lithium, bromine, and other essential elements. Operating from its global headquarters in Charlotte, NC, Albemarle serves customers in approximately 70 countries with world-class hard-rock and brine lithium resources, state-of-the-art lithium conversion facilities, advanced lithium material and process development, bromine production facilities, and the US's only producing lithium resource in Silver Peak, NV. The company serves critical markets including electric vehicle batteries, energy storage, flame retardants, pharmaceutical ingredients, catalysts, and specialty chemicals, employing approximately 7,800 people and holding over 1,500 active patents worldwide.

providers.name: Syzygy Plasmonics
providers.description: Syzygy Plasmonics is a Houston, Texas deep-decarbonization company commercializing photocatalytic chemical manufacturing. Its Rigel reactor cell uses photonic energy from renewable electricity in place of combustion heat to drive reforming reactions, and its NovaSAF / GHG e-Reforming pathway converts waste biogas into low-carbon sustainable aviation fuel, independently assessed as eligible for both ISCC EU RFNBO and Advanced BioSAF certification. Adjacent targets include hydrogen from ammonia e-cracking, syngas, methanol, butadiene and other commodity chemicals, sold as reactor hardware plus a licensing and front-end engineering support package. Syzygy is a hardware and process-licensing business, not a software vendor: as of 2026-08-29 it publishes no developer portal, API reference, SDK, or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Westlake
providers.description: Westlake Corporation is a global Fortune 500 manufacturer and supplier of materials and innovative products that enhance life every day. The company produces chemical materials and building products across multiple sectors including packaging, healthcare, automotive, consumer goods, and construction. Westlake operates through two primary segments: Performance and Essential Materials (PEM) and Housing and Infrastructure Products (HIP), with net sales of approximately $11 billion annually.

providers.name: Graphite Innovation and Technologies
providers.description: Graphite Innovation and Technologies Inc, operating as GIT Coatings, is a Canadian materials-science company that develops sustainable, graphene-based marine coatings for commercial ships. Its biocide-free hard foul-release hull and propeller coatings, including XGIT-FORCE, XGIT-VORTEX, and XGIT-PROP, cut fuel consumption, reduce drag, and eliminate leaching to protect the marine environment. The company is a Techstars-backed portfolio company. It is a physical-products manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company-level discovery and coverage.

providers.name: CMC Materials
providers.description: CMC Materials is a global supplier of consumable materials primarily to the semiconductor industry, including chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) slurries and polishing pads. Acquired by Entegris in 2022, CMC's materials portfolio is now part of the Entegris specialty chemicals and CMP solutions business, serving semiconductor manufacturers through advanced materials and process technologies.

providers.name: Eastman Chemical
providers.description: Driven by more than 100 years of continuous innovation, Eastman is a global Fortune 500 specialty materials company that produces a broad range of advanced materials, chemicals, and fibers used in everyday products. Eastman operates a customer-facing Customer Center for orders, documents, and Safety Data Sheets, but no public developer portal or REST API has been documented.

providers.name: Enko Chem
providers.description: Enko Chem, Inc. (Enko) is an agricultural life sciences company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Mystic, Connecticut, where it operates an 89,000 sq ft research lab and greenhouse campus. Enko discovers and develops next-generation crop protection chemistry — weed, disease, insect and soil-pest control — using its proprietary ENKOMPASS platform, which combines DNA-encoded library screening, structure-based design, artificial intelligence and machine learning to identify new modes of action and lead molecules faster and at lower cost than conventional agrochemical R&D. Enko works through partnerships with Syngenta, Bayer, Nufarm and the Gates Foundation Strategic Investment Fund rather than selling software, and publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Genomatica
providers.description: Genomatica (which markets itself as Geno) is a San Diego, California biotechnology and sustainable materials company founded in 1998 that engineers microbes and fermentation processes to make widely used chemical building blocks from plants instead of fossil fuels. Its commercialized process technology covers Geno BDO (bio-based 1,4-butanediol, licensed to partners including BASF and Novamont), Brontide butylene glycol for personal care, Avela (R)-1,3-butanediol, plant-based nylon-6 intermediates developed with lululemon and manufacturing partners such as Hyosung and Sojitz, plus palm-oil alternatives and fragrance building blocks. Genomatica licenses its process technology to chemical producers rather than operating a software platform; as of this profile it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, machine-readable specification, or agent-facing discovery surface.

providers.name: Mitra Chem
providers.description: Mitra Chem is an AI-enabled innovator and manufacturer of battery and critical materials for energy, AI infrastructure and defense applications, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Mountain View, California. Its first commercial product is iron-based lithium iron phosphate (LFP) and lithium manganese iron phosphate (LMFP) cathode active material produced for Western battery cell makers and energy-storage OEMs as a non-China supply source. The company operates The Foundry, an instrumented shared pilot manufacturing facility spanning wet chemistry, hydrometallurgy, particle sizing, drying and heat treatment, and runs an internal full-stack AI platform of physics-based models, digital twins and engineering co-pilots used to compress materials scale-up cost and timelines. The AI platform is internal tooling for Mitra Chem's own manufacturing operations; it is not sold or exposed as a software product, and the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: LiquidLight
providers.description: LiquidLight, Inc. (Liquid Light) was an electrochemistry company based in Monmouth Junction, New Jersey that developed and licensed process technology for converting carbon dioxide into industrial chemicals. Founded in 2009 by Kyle Teamey, Emily Cole, Andrew Bocarsly, Fouad Elnaggar and Nety Krishna around technology licensed from Princeton University, the company built a portfolio of more than 100 patents covering the electrochemical production of chemicals including monoethylene glycol (MEG), propylene and acetic acid, with MEG as its lead target market. It raised seed funding from Redpoint Ventures and a $15 million Series B in September 2014 from investors including VantagePoint Capital Partners and BP Ventures, and was also a Battery Ventures portfolio investment. Avantium acquired Liquid Light on January 10, 2017 and the company ceased operating independently. LiquidLight was a materials and process-technology company: it never published a public API, developer portal, SDKs or any machine-readable developer surface, and no company web property survives the acquisition. This profile is retained in the API Evangelist network as an accurate, non-API portfolio record.

providers.name: RecommerceX
providers.description: RecommerceX is an engineering-driven manufacturing company applying circular-economy practices to transform industrial waste into advanced engineering materials. It operates three flagship brands: RexSteel (seamless and ERW stainless steel pipes, tubes, forgings, flanges and heat-exchanger tubes), RexPol (HDPE and DWC polymer pipes, polymer compounds and engineering plastics), and RexTherm (critical infrastructure including liquid cooling, heat exchangers, power components and acoustics). It serves oil & gas, chemical, pharmaceutical, infrastructure, automotive, water, power and industrial manufacturing sectors. Surfaced as a portfolio company of accel and added to the API Evangelist network; the public site publishes no API, SDK, developer portal, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Archimetis
providers.description: Archimetis builds an AI-powered Operational Reasoning System for refineries, chemicals, and heavy process industries. The platform unifies data from disparate operational sources — plant historians, linear programs, advanced process control models, and digital engineering documents — into a single intelligence layer, then continuously monitors operations, performs complex engineering analysis, and applies industry best practices to surface actionable insights for operators and engineers. Marketed as "See more. Solve smarter," it targets margin improvement, cost savings, and process safety across refining, chemicals, and other heavy industries. Founded in 2023, the company raised $11.5M led by Inspired Capital. Archimetis is an enterprise B2B platform engaged through guided working sessions and demos; it does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: Calumet
providers.description: Calumet is a specialty hydrocarbon and renewable fuels company that produces a broad portfolio of branded and customer-formulated specialty products including lubricating oils, white mineral oils, solvents, waxes, and renewable diesel through its Montana Renewables subsidiary. The company serves customers across consumer, industrial, and energy markets globally. Calumet does not publish a public developer API portal.

providers.name: FMC Corporation
providers.description: FMC Corporation is a Philadelphia-headquartered global agricultural sciences company that develops and supplies crop protection products including herbicides, insecticides, fungicides, and biological solutions, alongside precision agriculture technology. Originally founded as the Food Machinery Corporation, the modern FMC focuses on productivity and resilience for growers worldwide. This repository tracks the FMC Corporation entity and any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts. No public APIs or developer programs are currently published. Note that "FMC" is also commonly used as an abbreviation for the legacy FMC Technologies brand (now TechnipFMC), which is tracked separately under the fmc-technologies repository.

providers.name: Huntsman Corporation
providers.description: Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global chemical manufacturer of differentiated and specialty chemicals serving a diverse range of consumer and industrial end markets, with operating segments in polyurethanes, performance products, and advanced materials. Huntsman maintains a Technology Portal for partner collaborations, but no public developer APIs have been identified at this time.

providers.name: MITO Material Solutions
providers.description: MITO Material Solutions (MITO Materials) is a specialty chemical company that develops patented hybrid additive technology to strengthen composite and thermoplastic materials. Its platform functionalizes graphene and biomaterials to improve strength, durability, flexibility, and sustainability without requiring changes to a manufacturer's existing process. Core products include the MITO hybrid additive platform, MITO E-GO, MITO E-GO Res-1, and MITO ACRE, serving the sports and recreation, transportation, automotive, and infrastructure industries. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and was added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this pass, MITO publishes no developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tidal Vision
providers.description: Tidal Vision Products, Inc. is a Bellingham, Washington biotechnology and specialty-chemicals manufacturer, and the only commercial-scale US producer of chitosan — a non-toxic, non-hazmat, biodegradable industrial biopolymer upcycled from crab and shrimp shell waste. Its zero-waste Chitofining process extracts, modifies and formulates chitosan chemistries that displace PFAS, halogenated chemicals, toxic antimicrobials and persistent plastics across three business lines: Tidal Clear water and wastewater treatment, Tidal Grow AgriScience crop and soil inputs, and Tidal-Tec Biomaterial Science performance materials. The company closed an oversubscribed $140M+ Series B in 2025 and acquired Clear Water Services. It is a materials-science manufacturer and publishes no public developer program, API, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Axalta Coating Systems
providers.description: Axalta Coating Systems is a global supplier of liquid and powder coatings for transportation and industrial end-markets, operating through Performance Coatings (refinish and industrial) and Mobility Coatings (light vehicle and commercial vehicle) segments. Brands include Cromax, Spies Hecker, Standox, Imron, and Voltatex. In July 2024 Axalta acquired The CoverFlexx Group from Transtar Holding for $285 million to expand its economy-tier aftermarket coverage in North America. In November 2025 Axalta announced a $17 billion all-stock merger of equals with AkzoNobel that is expected to close in late 2026 or early 2027, forming a coatings company with dual headquarters in Amsterdam and Philadelphia.

providers.name: LyondellBasell
providers.description: LyondellBasell Industries N.V. (NYSE: LYB) is one of the world's largest producers of polymers and plastic resins, including polyethylene, polypropylene, and specialty polyolefins such as Catalloy and Polybutene-1. The company also produces chemicals, fuels, polyolefin process technology, and advanced polymer solutions, and operates a Circular & Low Carbon Solutions (CLCS) business marketing CirculenRecover and CirculenRenew recycled and renewable polymers. LyondellBasell has no public developer program, no API documentation, and no source code published in its (empty) GitHub organization. In January 2025 the company began the permanent closure of its Houston Refining facility — the 263,776 bpd, full-conversion plant that was the first refinery on the Houston Ship Channel when it opened in 1918 — eliminating more than 400 jobs and exiting the refining business entirely. Profiled as a Tier 3 industrial / no-APIs provider for portfolio completeness.

providers.name: Chemtura
providers.description: Chemtura Corporation was a global specialty chemicals company that developed, manufactured, and marketed chemical intermediates, additives, specialty chemicals, urethanes, organometallics, and modern plastics. In April 2017, Chemtura was acquired by LANXESS AG, the German specialty chemicals company headquartered in Cologne, and its operations were integrated into LANXESS's Performance Materials and other business segments. Chemtura products are now marketed and supported through LANXESS, which continues to serve agriculture, animal care, mobility, consumer goods, electrical and electronics, energy, food, and healthcare end markets.

providers.name: Ecolab
providers.description: Ecolab is a Fortune 500 global leader in water, hygiene, and infection prevention solutions and services. The company helps customers in food, healthcare, hospitality, industrial, and energy markets keep their environments clean, safe, and healthy while protecting people and vital resources.

providers.name: Hanqi Group
providers.description: Beijing Hanqi Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. (Hanqi Group) is a Beijing-based environmental technology company specializing in full-process chemical and oily wastewater treatment for the petrochemical, coal-chemical, new-energy, industrial-park, and municipal sectors. With roughly 17 years of operating history, 140+ client references, and 80+ patents across physicochemical, biochemical, and oxidation process categories, Hanqi delivers engineered water-treatment technologies and services rather than software. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Public research confirms no developer, API, SDK, or agent surface exists for this provider.

providers.name: Hexion
providers.description: Hexion is a global leader in thermosetting resins, providing a broad range of adhesive, structural, and specialty resins to a wide variety of industries including coatings, construction, electronics, and automotive. Their purpose is to activate science to change our world.

providers.name: Olin
providers.description: Olin Corporation is a leading global manufacturer and distributor of chemical products and ammunition. Olin operates three business segments: Chlor Alkali Products and Vinyls, Epoxy, and Winchester. No public APIs have been documented at this time.

providers.name: PPG Industries
providers.description: PPG Industries is a Fortune 500 global supplier of paints, coatings, and specialty materials serving customers in construction, consumer products, industrial, transportation markets, and aftermarkets. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts associated with PPG Industries. As of the last review, no public APIs or developer portal have been identified.

providers.name: Rise Reforming
providers.description: Rise Reforming is a climate-technology company that converts underutilized and flared waste biogas into valuable chemicals such as dimethyl ether (DME) and methanol. It deploys a modular, on-site reforming process at biogas sources like wastewater treatment plants, enabling localized, supply-secure chemical production and reducing dependence on centralized, fossil-fuel-based chemical manufacturing. A Y Combinator (Summer 2026) company, it is building the first wastewater biogas-to-methanol demonstration in the Americas at a Chicagoland wastewater facility. As a hardware and chemical-process company, it currently publishes no public web API, developer portal, or software SDK surface.

providers.name: Rohm and Haas
providers.description: Rohm and Haas Company was an American specialty chemicals manufacturer founded in 1909 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The company produced electronic materials, specialty polymers, adhesives, coatings, paints, and process chemicals. On April 1, 2009, Rohm and Haas was acquired by The Dow Chemical Company for approximately $18.8 billion in cash and stock. The Rohm and Haas brand has since been largely retired and its product lines, technologies, and businesses have been integrated into Dow (now Dow Inc., NYSE: DOW). Some legacy product brands persist under Dow but the standalone company no longer exists.

providers.name: Solugen
providers.description: Solugen is a chemical manufacturing company that produces sustainable industrial chemicals through its proprietary Bioforge platform, which combines engineered enzymes, metal catalysis, and modular process design to convert renewable feedstocks into products with minimal waste. Solugen serves markets including oil and gas, renewable fuels, aerospace and defense, water treatment, cleaning, agriculture, concrete, and personal care. Backed by Founders Fund, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; as of this enrichment pass Solugen publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable developer surface.

providers.name: Exxon Mobil
providers.description: Exxon Mobil Corporation is one of the world's largest publicly traded international energy companies, exploring for, producing, and refining oil and natural gas and manufacturing petroleum and chemical products. This repository tracks any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable artifacts associated with Exxon Mobil.

providers.name: Entegris
providers.description: Entegris is a global supplier of advanced materials and process solutions for the semiconductor and other high-technology industries. The company develops and manufactures specialty chemicals, gases, filtration and purification systems, advanced materials handling, and process control products. No public developer API or developer portal has been identified at the corporate level; technical integration is typically supported through sales engineering, the supplier portal, and product documentation.

providers.name: MicroByre
providers.description: MicroByre was a Berkeley, California synthetic biology company founded in 2017 by CEO and co-founder Sarah Richardson to "domesticate" wild-type bacteria — building an automated characterization and genetic-tool pipeline that made naturally occurring, never-before-engineered microbes tractable so they could ferment unrefined waste biomass into commodity chemicals, enzymes, food ingredients and probiotics at costs petrochemical routes could not match. It raised roughly $20.5M, including backing from Prime Coalition's Prime Impact Fund, and went out of business; Prime Coalition lists it as "no longer active" and C&EN reported the shutdown. MicroByre was a wet-lab platform company, not a software vendor: it published no developer program, no API, and no machine-readable contract, and its own domain no longer resolves to a web server.

providers.name: NewMarket Corporation
providers.description: NewMarket Corporation (NYSE: NEU) is a publicly traded specialty chemicals holding company headquartered in Richmond, Virginia. Through subsidiaries Afton Chemical and Ethyl Corporation, NewMarket develops petroleum additives for fuels and lubricants used worldwide.

providers.name: Dow
providers.description: Dow Inc. is a global materials science company headquartered in Midland, Michigan. Dow combines science and technology to develop innovative products and solutions for packaging, infrastructure, mobility, and consumer applications. This entry is an alias of dow-chemical and covers the same parent company.

providers.name: Arzeda
providers.description: Arzeda Corp is a Seattle, Washington protein design company — "The Protein Design Company" — founded in 2008 by David Baker (2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry), Alexandre Zanghellini and colleagues out of the University of Washington Institute for Protein Design. Its Intelligent Protein Design Technology combines physics-based computational protein design, generative AI and an agentic design-build-test-learn loop over fifteen years of proprietary in-house experimental data to create designer enzymes and proteins that do not exist in nature, then scale them to commercial production. Commercial programs span food and beverage (ViaLeaf Reb M / ProSweet Reb M stevia sweeteners with MANE), home and personal care enzymes (Unilever), advanced materials (W. L. Gore & Associates) and pharmaceutical biologics (Takeda), alongside DARPA and NSF funded work on AI-driven protein design and cell-free biomanufacturing. Arzeda co-founded the OpenFold consortium for open-source protein structure prediction. It sells designed molecules and joint development programs, not software, and publishes no public developer program, API or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Dow Chemical
providers.description: Dow Chemical, now operating as Dow Inc., is a global materials science company headquartered in Midland, Michigan. Dow develops innovative products and solutions across three segments - Packaging and Specialty Plastics, Industrial Intermediates and Infrastructure, and Performance Materials and Coatings - serving packaging, infrastructure, mobility, and consumer applications.

providers.name: DuPont
providers.description: DuPont is a leading solutions provider for healthcare, water, and a broad range of industrial segments, powered by high-performance engineered products, leading-edge application development, and top-tier manufacturing. No public developer APIs or developer portal have been identified at this time; this index captures DuPont's web presence for monitoring future developer activity.

providers.name: Momentive Performance Materials
providers.description: Momentive Performance Materials is a global silicones and advanced materials company that produces specialty silicones, urethane additives, and quartz technologies for industrial and consumer markets.

providers.name: Nexeo Solutions Holdings
providers.description: Nexeo Solutions was a leading global chemicals and plastics distributor before being acquired by Univar Solutions in 2019. This index tracks any developer resources or APIs associated with the legacy Nexeo Solutions brand.

providers.name: Calumet Specialty Products Partners
providers.description: Calumet, Inc. (NASDAQ: CLMT) is a publicly traded U.S. manufacturing company established in 1919, headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. The firm specializes in the manufacture of lubricating oils, solvents, waxes, packaged and synthetic specialty products, fuels, renewable diesel, and fuel-related products. It operates 12 production facilities across North America and serves approximately 2,700 global customers in over 90 countries through brands including Royal Purple, Bel-Ray, Penreco, Orchex, and TruFuel. Calumet does not publish a public developer API program; commercial integrations are handled via B2B portals and EDI.

providers.name: Phillips 66
providers.description: Phillips 66 is a diversified energy manufacturing and logistics company with midstream, chemicals, refining, and marketing and specialties businesses. This repository captures any APIs, developer tools, and machine-readable API artifacts for Phillips 66.

providers.name: CDI Corp
providers.description: CDI Corp (CDI Corporation) is a multidisciplinary engineering and technical resourcing firm founded in Philadelphia in 1950 as Comprehensive Designers, Inc., later listed on the NYSE from 1988 to 2017. After being taken private by AE Industrial Partners in September 2017 for approximately $176M ($8.25 per share), AE divested CDI's aerospace business to Belcan (2017), talent and technology services to Artech (2018), and architecture/engineering subsidiary L.R. Kimball to TranSystems (2021), refocusing the remaining CDI Engineering Solutions on integrated engineering, design, project support, procurement, and construction management for the energy and chemicals industries. On January 1, 2025 CDI Engineering Solutions, LLC became a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Consulting Engineers and now trades as Tata Consulting Engineers USA, LLC, headquartered in Houston, TX with 650+ employees across ten engineering centers. CDI Corp has no public developer APIs; the company delivers engineering services and staff augmentation rather than software products. The tagline carried by the operating business is "Quality Results. Sustainable Solutions. Safely Delivered."

providers.name: Chevron
providers.description: Chevron Corporation is one of the world's largest integrated energy companies, with operations across upstream exploration and production, downstream refining and marketing, and the production and transportation of crude oil, natural gas, refined fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and renewable fuels. Chevron is headquartered in Houston, Texas, and operates globally under brands including Chevron, Texaco, and Caltex. Chevron does not currently publish a public consumer-facing developer API; supplier and partner integrations are handled through the Chevron Invoice and Payment Status (CIPS) system and the Supplier Relations channels, and investors and stakeholders are served through corporate, sustainability, and IR websites.

providers.name: Fujian Deer Technology
providers.description: Fujian Deer Technology (福建德尔科技股份有限公司) is a Chinese specialty-chemicals manufacturer founded in June 2014 and headquartered in the Jiaoyang Industrial Concentration Zone, Shanghang County, Longyan City, Fujian Province. The company pursues a full fluorine-chemistry industry-chain strategy, researching, producing and selling basic chemical materials, fluorine-containing electronic gases, high-purity semiconductor wet electronic chemicals, new-energy (lithium battery) materials and other fluorinated advanced materials. Its electronic-grade gases include trifluoromethane, carbon tetrafluoride, sulfur hexafluoride, hexafluoroethane, chlorine trifluoride and octafluorocyclobutane, supplied into semiconductor chips, LED chips, flat-panel displays, communications optical fibre, power and energy-storage batteries, ultra-high-voltage transmission and transformation, and photovoltaic power generation. It is a designated national high-tech enterprise and is privately held; its shares appear on secondary-market venues. It manufactures physical materials and publishes no public API, developer program or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Praxair
providers.description: Praxair was an American multinational industrial gases company that merged with Linde AG in 2018 to form Linde plc. Praxair operations in the United States now operate as Linde. The company supplies atmospheric, process, and specialty gases, along with related equipment and services to a range of industries.

providers.name: sh-eco
providers.description: SH-ECO (翊科聚合物 / Yike Polymer) is a Chinese medical-device materials manufacturer specializing in the research, production, and customized fabrication of medical catheters and membrane materials. Its product range spans single-lumen tubing, multi-lumen tubing, composite/multi-layer tubing, and injection-molded components serving healthcare and multiple industrial applications. The company is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. It publishes a corporate marketing website but exposes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Axiall
providers.description: Axiall Corporation is a manufacturer and international marketer of chemicals and building products, including chlorovinyls and aromatics, for use in industrial and consumer applications.

providers.name: Vertex Energy
providers.description: Vertex Energy is an energy transition company specializing in producing and marketing high-purity refined products including conventional fuels, renewable diesel, and other specialty products. The company operates refining and processing facilities and is engaged in the recycling and recovery of used motor oil and other petroleum byproducts. No public developer API or technical documentation portal is currently available.

providers.name: Chemours
providers.description: Fortune 1000 company Chemours. Public API documentation has not yet been catalogued in the API Evangelist network.

regulatory.note: provider carries no tags; regime could not be determined

providers.name: AnalytiChem
providers.description: AnalytiChem is a global manufacturer of laboratory supplies, producing certified reference materials, specialized laboratory consumables, and sample-preparation systems for life sciences, environmental, materials, and lab-essentials markets. Its product families span ready-to-use culture media for microbial monitoring in pharmaceutical, food, beverage and environmental testing; laboratory standards for measuring heavy metals, pesticides and other contaminants; reference materials for the petrochemical, mining, metals and EV-battery industries; and reagents and solvents for chemical work and sample analysis. The company operates under ISO 17034, ISO 17025 and ISO 9001 quality accreditations. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass AnalytiChem publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: ChemConnect
providers.description: ChemConnect, Inc. was a Houston, Texas-based electronic exchange (founded 1995) for trading midstream energy, feedstocks, chemicals, and related commodities such as natural gas liquids, refined and intermediate fuels, aromatics, olefins, and commodity polymers, serving thousands of member companies with e-commerce, market information, negotiation, and supply-chain collaboration tooling. It acquired rival CheMatch to form a leading commodity trading platform. The company is a now-exited Battery Ventures portfolio investment; it no longer operates and the chemconnect.com domain is parked and listed for sale (HugeDomains), so there is no live developer, API, or documentation surface to enrich.

providers.name: Downstream Energy
providers.description: Downstream Energy is a software company that provides business-to-business electronic commerce solutions for the refined petrochemical and downstream petroleum industry, supporting the buying and selling of refined products such as gasoline, distillate, propane, and jet fuel. It is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. No public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specification has been located for this provider during enrichment, so the profile remains a lightly enriched identity stub pending discovery of a public API surface.

providers.name: 大易有塑 (dayi35.com)
providers.description: dayi35.com (大易有塑, Dayi Yousu) is a Chinese business-to-business e-commerce and trading platform for plastics and chemical raw materials, operated out of Dongguan, Guangdong. The platform runs an online mall covering general-purpose plastics (ABS, EVA, GPPS, HIPS, LLDPE), engineering plastics (PA6, PA66, PBT, PC, PET, PMMA, PPS, LCP), modified and recycled resins, and chemical additives such as titanium dioxide, carbon black, flame retardants and release agents. Alongside the mall it operates a buyer request-for-quote board (求购), a daily domestic and international price and market-data service, industry news, and supply-chain services spanning warehousing, logistics distribution, and e-commerce enablement for plastics and chemicals enterprises. Buyer and seller activity runs through an authenticated member console at /uc. The site is filed under Chinese ICP licence 粤ICP备15037802号.
